## Professional summary
AD3N1X is the professional developer identity of Adeniran Victor Adebowale, a Nigeria-based full-stack software developer and software engineering student focused on building and improving independent web applications. Public work includes frontend interfaces, full-stack application workflows, commerce tools, public-source research, productivity software, and interactive learning projects. Project status and capabilities should be described only as evidenced by each linked project.

## Technical interests
React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, MongoDB, SQL, authentication, validation, responsive interfaces, software testing, Git, and deployment workflows. Python is a current learning focus; TypeScript is a planned next step.
